body:
> [!NOTE]
> ClimaAtmos 0.42.17 and ClimaLand 1.14.0 require ClimaDiagnostics 0.4, so this PR also relaxes the ClimaDiagnostics compat in the root `Project.toml` to `"0.3.9, 0.4"`. This is the same change as the CompatHelper PR #2190, so whichever of the two is merged second will have a trivial conflict.

## Purpose

Dependency update of the AMIP environment: `Pkg.update()` of `experiments/AMIP/Manifest.toml` (Julia 1.10) and `experiments/AMIP/Manifest-v1.11.toml` (Julia 1.11), picking up the ClimaAtmos 0.42.17 and ClimaLand 1.14.0 releases. The CMIP manifests are not touched (they have their own `ClimaDiagnostics = "0.3.9"` compat).

## Content

| Package | AMIP (1.10 and 1.11) | Note |
|---|---|---|
| ClimaAtmos | 0.42.15 → **0.42.17** | |
| ClimaLand | 1.13.0 → **1.14.0** | |
| ClimaDiagnostics | 0.3.11 → **0.4.0** | required by ClimaAtmos 0.42.17 and ClimaLand 1.14.0; breaking, see below |
| CloudMicrophysics | 0.45.0 → 0.47.0 | required by ClimaAtmos 0.42.16 |
| SurfaceFluxes | 1.5.1 → **1.6.0** | required by ClimaLand 1.14.0 |
| ClimaCore | 1.0.4 → 1.0.6 | |
| ClimaParams | 1.3.2 → 1.3.4 | |
| ClimaAnalysis | 0.5.24 → 0.5.25 | |
| RRTMGP | 1.1.0 → 1.1.1 | |
| Makie / CairoMakie | 0.24.16 → 0.24.15 / 0.15.16 → 0.15.15 (1.10 only) | back within the `Makie = "=0.24.15"` pin of #2169 |
| HDF5_jll / NetCDF_jll | 2.2.3 → 1.14.2 / 401.1000.101 → 400.902.209 | resolver downgrade, also seen in ClimaLand; drops the `aws_*` S3 jlls |

plus about 150 minor and patch updates. CUDA stays at 5.11.3 (`CUDA = "5"` in the AMIP compat).

Apart from ClimaDiagnostics, all of these are within the existing compat entries, so the ClimaDiagnostics entry in the root `Project.toml` is the only compat change. ClimaLand 1.14.0 deprecates `surface_height` and the form of `turbulent_fluxes_at_a_point` without a reference, which `ClimaCouplerClimaLandExt/climaland_bucket.jl` uses; both are kept for ClimaCoupler.

### ClimaDiagnostics 0.4

Breaking changes that affect the AMIP output (from the [v0.4.0 release notes](https://github.com/CliMA/ClimaDiagnostics.jl/releases/tag/v0.4.0)):

- Time-reduced diagnostics no longer include the state at initialization, so the first reduction window has one sample fewer than before.
- `NetCDFWriter` no longer writes the `date` and `date_bnds` variables; `time` now has units `seconds since <start date>` and calendar `proleptic_gregorian`.
- The `init_time` keyword of `NetCDFWriter` is removed.

No code in ClimaCoupler passes `init_time` or reads `date`/`date_bnds`, so no source changes are needed.
